notes.title: Demo Major Update - UI Renewal and Many Improvements
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="YAcmGLm9DHs;full"][/previewyoutube]


There have been countless fixes since the demo release, and this time I’ve made another major round of updates.

I ran an event where players could get a key by sharing gameplay footage, and many people joined in. Among them, Lori completely redesigned the UI, which turned out so much better than the original that I rebuilt everything over three weeks. Lori also kept giving feedback during the process. I’ve already thanked him several times, but I’d like to take this chance to thank him again.

Thanks to all the feedback, I was able to fix many unexpected bugs and improve the flow of progression. Especially in the early game, a lot has changed to account for playstyles I hadn’t anticipated.

I also moved the boss hall further back, replacing the old spot with a new hall focused on story content and wall jump practice. The wall jump itself has been greatly improved as well.

It’s the first time I’ve received so much help from people I didn’t even know, and it made me realize I should be someone who can help others, too. Once again, thank you.

Miscellaneous
 Negredo Gate event

 Boss battle improvements

 World map UI, and other UI fixes

Next Stage in Development: Threshold
Threshold, currently in development and not included in the demo, is a cache-like space between reality and Beyond—the virtual world where the dead are backed up. Unlike Beyond, Threshold doesn’t mimic reality precisely. It often breaks physical laws and serves as a transitional system zone.

notes.title: Demo Major Update – New Trailer Out
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=lXq8HX8fqbA;full][/previewyoutube]

Since the demo launch on April 1st, I've made major changes based on community feedback. Here's what’s new:

[olist]
 Unlocked Traversal Freedom
Acrobatic movement is now available much earlier, with location restrictions removed entirely. This opens up the world after the initial tutorial, giving players more freedom to explore and experiment with movement-based mechanics. Quest progression was also adjusted to allow for more open-ended exploration, and several areas were reworked to support freer traversal.

 Lightweight Dialogue System
You no longer need to open the dialogue window every time—conversations now appear as compact messages on the right side of the screen. Keyboard users can adjust the display speed of these messages on the fly, and all players can do so via Settings > Game Settings > Dialog Display Speed.

 Boss Fight Improvements
I've addressed frustrating elements in the boss fight by making key mechanics more readable and reducing the overall difficulty. These changes make the fight fairer and more responsive while keeping it engaging.
[/olist]

In total, over 200 improvements and fixes have been made, ranging from input handling and performance to UI and narrative flow.

A new trailer is now available to reflect these changes.
Thanks again for all your support and feedback.
